name: ca77y-engineering
description: Idea-to-shipped development pipeline as Claude Code subagents, driven by skills the user runs in the main session: the analyst skill (shapes stories + records cards on the board), the lead skill (run in the main session, it takes one task from a prompt or a story card to a single PR — no splitting, no merging, dispatching the workers flat and driving the PR review loop), the board skill (helps a project write or repair the BOARD.md declaration that every board-touching agent reads directly, at a fixed path, with no per-run resolution step), the forge skill (the same, for the FORGE.md declaration that records the repository and remote, the target branch, the worktree directory, the branch and commit conventions, and how a change is opened and its review re-fired — the lead reads it before it creates a workspace, and stops the run when it is absent), writer (authors the task's spec and scores its coding complexity, then its docs), junior-coder and senior-coder (the two build tiers — the lead routes the build on that score, below 5 to the junior and 5 or above to the senior, falling back to the senior when the score cannot be read and promoting to it when a problem survives three rounds), qa (the lead's validation and independent local code review of the build), auditor (the spec-readiness gate, the acceptance gate, plus the analyst's story advisor). Deep research and the project's Markdown research library live in the companion ca77y-library plugin — the analyst uses its librarian and clerk when they are installed, and works from the wiki pages directly when they are not.
